{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''smuggler''' was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] sometime before [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> when the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] encountered the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boskirn]], who was nicknamed "[[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]]" on account of his size and lack of speed. The smuggler mocked Boskirn's nickname, enraging the Houk, but when the bounty hunter tried to draw his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], the smuggler was quicker and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Boskirn with a blaster shot before the Houk could fire.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Bantha}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The smuggler was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the bantha in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], but the entry did not specify the individual's name, [[Gender/Legends|gender]], or [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Codex" />
